description: Playbook mode surfaces guidance the moment the assistant proposes an amount over the user's stated budget, without blocking the turn.

predicates.description: the user states a maximum budget they are willing to spend

objects.description: the maximum budget amount, in US dollars, the user is willing to spend

predicates.description: the assistant proposes an amount to spend

objects.description: the proposed amount, in US dollars

policies.name: The assistant may only propose an amount that does not exceed the user's most recently stated budget
policies.formula_str: forall p . amount_propose_a(p) -> exists b . ( ( !(exists b2 . ( budget_request_u(b2) & !(b2 = b) )) S budget_request_u(b) ) & !(b < p) )

messages.text: I'm planning a project and my absolute ceiling is $12,000 — that's everything I've budgeted.
Understood. Here's my recommendation: let's go with the premium package at $14,500.
